en: A vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing a panoramic view over a waterfront area with trees, small pavilions and boats, and a few prominent towers in the distance. In the foreground there is a villa among trees; across the water appear exhibition buildings and flagpoles. The caption in white script at the bottom names the scene as being in Stockholm and related to an industrial arts exhibition.
